title: driver/report.json (the engine's answer to one step instruction)
description: What the engine says it did, under .dabbler/runs/s<N>/driver/report.json. Written only by `dabbler session report`, which shapes the flags into this record, validates it, and replaces the file whole; the engine never writes it by hand, and a file that fails validation on read is refused, never skipped. The verb checks the shape. The driver checks the substance -- that `seq` is the outstanding instruction's, that `step_id` is the step it asked for, that every listed file exists and matches what the tree changed, and that the step's own check passes -- and issues a rejection with the reasons when it does not.

schema_version.description: Frozen at v1. A reader that finds any other value refuses the file rather than interpreting it.

seq.description: The seq of the instruction this answers.

status.description: Two words. `blocked` is the engine saying it could not finish, with `notes` saying why; there is no word for a verdict, because the engine has none to give.

items.description: Repository-relative, forward slashes, no `.` or `..` segments, never absolute.

files_changed.description: Every file the engine created or changed for this step.

tests_run.description: The test command the engine ran, or null when it ran none.

notes.description: One line for the log. People read it; the driver does not.
